articles.title: Vampir Is a Dark, Brutal MMORPG Focused on Bloody Violence
articles.summary: The MMORPG genre has been woefully lacking in vampire representation, but into that void steps Netmarble’s Vampir. It first launched in South Korea in 2025 before recently expanding to the West, and it’s now available in the U.S. on PC, iOS, and Android.
body: This is a game that really leans into the full vampire experience. It’s defined by blood, horror, and sexuality with brutal combat in a dark fantasy setting. From the start of the game, you’ll be treated to some gruesome scenes that set the tone of the world, and that tone carries into gameplay. There are five character classes to choose from, and they’re all aggressive damage dealers that can use vampires’ signature blood-draining abilities to restore HP and gain temporary combat buffs.

All the classes dish out death in stylish fashion, but the way they do it is very different. Carnage can use a variety of firearms with rapid-fire attacks. Bloodstained is a berserker with added durability that can channel its bloodlust into a powerful sword. Viper uses poisons, curses, and summoned creatures to deal AoE damage and control the battlefield. Grim Reaper is a stealth assassin that uses teleportation and a scythe to land critical strikes. And Akasha is a melee class that specializes in pursuing enemies.
points: The MMORPG genre has been woefully lacking in vampire representation, but into that void steps Netmarble’s Vampir.
It first launched in South Korea in 2025 before recently expanding to the West, and it’s now available in the U.S. on PC, iOS, and Android.

articles.title: This TSA-Compliant Daran 89.6Wh 100W LiFePO4 Power Station Drops to Just $49.99
articles.summary: Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon is offering the diminutive Daran 89.6Wh 100W Power Station for just $49.99 after applying coupon code " DDDD4999 ". Unlike previous iterations of this deal, you don't to be an Amazon Prime member to be eligible.
body: The Daran power station just 6.5" x 3.3" x 4" and weighs in at a portable 2.5 pounds. The 89.6W battery capacity (approximately 28,000mAh at 3.2V) is also TSA compliant, so you can bring it with you on your airplane flights.

It has a total of seven charging ports, including two 120V AC outlets (100W max), two USB-C ports (45W/15W), two USB-A ports (18W/15W), and a DC5521 port (60W). The 100W max output on the AC outlet is good for charging higher powered mobile electronics like your laptop, iPad, or handheld gaming PC, but it's also handy for older, legacy electronics that are powered by a traditional plug and not a USB cable.

The power station uses LiFePO4 cells instead of NCM cells you'd find in some other budget power stations. LiFePO4 cells have inherently safer chemistry, longer lifespan, and slower calendar aging than NCM cells. They are widely regarded as the best battery option for power stations.

articles.title: Nintendo’s Indie World Presentation Was Pretty Packed For A Short Show
articles.summary: The latest Indie World Showcase only lasted for a bit longer than 15 minutes, but that small time window didn't stop Nintendo from featuring some truly cool-looking games. The Witchbrook release date announcement kicked things off for the presentation.
body: That's because the next unveiling was Winds of Viridia, an action-adventure game from developer Shark Jump that appears inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. You play as a brown-haired boy who teams up with an adorable mothbug. But the cute companion is also apparently lethal against foes. Other things we're digging about this single-player title is how much the protagonist does stylistic spin moves as well as Hollow Knight: Silksong composer Christopher Larkin's involvement with the music. Plus, there's a demo available now on Switch 2, with a full release expected for early next year.

City of None followed up Winds of Viridia and kept our eyes glued to the screen. The retro pixel art is stunning, and this is coming from someone who feels burnt out by a lot of the throwback aesthetics these days. Maybe the changing four-color palette is what ultimately does it for me. Anyway, the action-puzzle platformer comes from Celeste co-creator Noel Berry--along with his brother, Liam. Celeste is one of my favorite 2D games of the past 10 years, so that connection alone has me standing up. City of None is coming to Switch and Switch 2 in 2027.

articles.title: The Ultra-Slim Baseus Blade 20,000mAh Power Bank Drops to $39 Ahead of Black Friday
articles.summary: Looking for a high-capacity, high-output power bank with an ultra-slim footprint? Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon has dropped the price of the Baseus Blade 20,000mAh 100W power bank to just $39.49 shipped after you apply coupon code " Z6J1ANOV ". You do NOT have to be an Amazon Prime member.
body: The Baseus Blade measures only 0.7 inches thick. Most high-capacity power banks are well over 1" in thickness. The Blade achieves this slim depth by going with a wider body design. The form factor allows it to fit perfectly in a laptop bag or backpack sleeve. It still weighs in at about one pound which is comparable to other power banks, so no give or take there.

The wide body allows it to squeeze in four ports: two USB Type-C ports each with 100W of Power Delivery and two USB Type-A ports each with 30W output. Note that the maximum charging output is 100W. That means although all three ports add up to a total of 160W, only a maximum of 100W will be delivered across all three ports if they are used simultaneously.

The Baseus Blade has USB Type-C ports that provides up to 100W of power output but it will automatically throttle down to whatever maximum rate the plugged-in device accepts. The Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 can only accept a maximum of 18W-30W of power output. The Steam Deck can accept up to 45W. The Legion Go S accepts up to 55W. The Xbox ROG Ally X can actually accept charging rates of up to 100W.
points: Looking for a high-capacity, high-output power bank with an ultra-slim footprint?

articles.title: If GTA 6 Beats Football On Thanksgiving, That’s A Win, EA Founder Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be a giant success commercially, but just how big does the game need to be to actually be successful following a decade of development and perhaps one of the biggest development budgets ever?
body: On the Sozzi Unleashed show, Gordon said it would be "mind-blowing" if GTA 6 can reach 75 million copies sold. How did he arrive at that number? Gordon said he was basing this on a number--750 million--a figure he thought a previous GTA 6 trailer reached. If GTA 6 can sell 10% of that, or 75 million copies, that would be a success, he said.

Gordon was referencing "the preview video," which might have been the GTA 6 Extended Look, which premiered on Netflix and then landed on YouTube. No single video for GTA 6 has 750 million views, but it's not a stretch to think GTA 6 videos distributed everywhere on the internet have reached that number collectively.
Also in the interview, Gordon said another sign of success for GTA 6 is if people play the game instead of watching football on Thanksgiving, which is just a few days after GTA 6 releases.
"I think from my point of view, what success for GTA 6 is going to be on Thanksgiving Day after eating your turkey, you don't watch football, you play GTA," he said.

articles.title: PlayStation Plus Free Games For November 2026 Revealed
articles.summary: PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus members will be able to claim a trio of freebies starting November 3: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider 4-6 Remastered, and Monster Train 2.
body: Long considered vaporware after its initial reveal in 2014, Dead Island 2 was eventually released in 2023. It's a first-person zombie-slaying game with a surprisingly deep RPG system, impressive amounts of gore, and at least one incredibly creepy undead clown boss fight. It was previously made available through the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog in 2024, but it was removed earlier this year. In case you missed it then, now is your chance to check it out.

Tomb Raider fans looking to celebrate Lara Croft's legacy can grab this compilation of classic games. It includes Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation, Tomb Raider: Chronicles, and Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness, all remastered with updated graphics. If you're feeling nostalgic, you can also switch back to the original polygonal look of these old-school games.

Lastly, Monster Train 2 is a real gem of a deckbuilding roguelite. The original game was pretty good, but the sequel improves on it with new gameplay features, a rich art direction, deep build variety, and a pretty rad soundtrack.

articles.title: Major 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' Game Finally Lives Up To The Hype
articles.summary: With its fantastic animation and incredible attention to detail, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game felt like it was destined for greatness. And perhaps the fighting game could have gone down as the best Avatar interactive experience ever made had it not been released in July 2026 without some key…
body: The game just received its fourth content update, and it's the biggest overhaul of the title yet. Avatar State Aang and Nightmare Korra, the powered-up forms of the series' protagonists, were redrawn from the ground up and now have new attacks and techniques. All the other characters have been rebalanced as well, though not quite to the same degree.

One of the biggest complaints players had around launch was Avatar Legends ' lack of a ranked mode, which made it difficult for newbie players to find their footing against expert players. The new patch fixes that issue with the addition of a ranked mode and a competitive ladder, as well as a brand-new spectator mode. Developer Gameplay Ground International is also promising beginner-friendly lobbies, new tutorials, and combo trials that break down advanced tactics. The idea is to help new players stick around for the long term — which is important when the game is about to launch on Switch 2 on October 29.

articles.title: Discord's Massive New Change Will Shake Up The Entire Internet
articles.summary: The best and worst thing about Discord is that messages sent on its chat servers are ephemeral. On the one hand, it's nice to know that things said in a casual setting won't necessarily be plastered on the internet forever.
body: Discord recently announced that communities with at least 1,000 members will soon start to see their messages appear on public search engines like Google. Such communities will generate what Discord calls a Server Web Page, and these will showcase summaries of discussions happening on public channels. Discord's blog post states that some, but not all, of the content shared on those widely accessible channels will gradually start to populate on Google beginning in December 2026.

The platform has effectively replaced web institutions like forums — and arguably, the lack of permanence is the only thing keeping it from supplanting other popular online communities such as Reddit. As of this writing, Reddit is estimated to have somewhere around 116 million daily active users compared to Discord's 90 million. Even taking into account that many Reddit users browse without logging in, the two platforms are nearly neck and neck. Added discoverability for Discord will undoubtedly help push the platform to more people who might not otherwise log into a server.
points: On the one hand, it's nice to know that things said in a casual setting won't necessarily be plastered on the internet forever.

articles.title: "This company has been driven into a wall for years" - Life is Strange studio Don't Nod faces unrest while teetering on insolvency
articles.summary: There's deep unrest at French studio Don't Nod - creator of Life is Strange, Remember Me, Vampyr, Banishers: New Eden, and most recently Aphelion - as it scrambles to restructure itself and guard against insolvency.
body: Indeed, an impassioned account of proceedings on French union Le Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo's website ( via Rock, Paper, Shotgun ) reveals Don't Nod has entered safeguard proceedings - a kind of last-ditch restructuring effort to stave off insolvency. It also reports that even though redundancies are being made,Don't Nod intends to finish making the in-development game codenamed P14, albeit relying more on outsourced development rather than its cut-down in-house team.

The report, which claims knowledge of a memo sent by Don't Nod CEO Oskar Guilbert, and of the goings-on of the Don't Nod employee representatives - the CSE - doubts whether Don't Nod will be able to finish the game. Apparently all of the studio's character artists, concept artists, most of its environment artists, most of its sound designers, game designers, level designers, programmers, producers, testers, and dev-ops have been let go.

"To compensate for this massacre and keep on running with production on a game that, to this day, didn't cut down on its scope and is keeping around a hundred persons busy, management is betting it all on outsourcing," the report says.

articles.title: Lord of the Rings’ New Aragorn Actor Officially Opens up on Role’s Immense Pressure
articles.summary: It can't be easy taking over a role from an actor who so perfectly portrayed the character before. Yet that is exactly what Jamie Dornan (Fifty Shades of Grey, Once Upon a Time ) is preparing to do. He will play Aragorn in The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, replacing Viggo Mortensen.
body: In an interview with L'Officiel (via Slash Film ), Dornan candidly said, "I've been asked to play a super-iconic role, and I'll do my best. But for me, Aragorn will always be just Viggo." Mortensen played Aragorn throughout Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings film trilogy. Dornan added, "I feel honored to try to recapture at least some of the energy he originally brought to the character." As for how he'll approach the character in the shadow of what came before, the newcomer said, "There’s no part of me that’s trying to outdo him.”

Dornan will be in a unique position amongst the cast, as other iconic Lord of the Rings characters will be reprised by actors from the original films. This includes Elijah Wood and Ian McKellen as Frodo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, respectively. Director Andy Serkis, who will once again portray Gollum, has revealed the film will use some digital de-aging technology for returning cast members, so the choice to recast Aragorn is an interesting one.
points: It can't be easy taking over a role from an actor who so perfectly portrayed the character before.

articles.title: How to open the Nameless Ruins chest in Final Fantasy Resonance
articles.summary: You're greeted with a sealed chest in Final Fantasy Resonance 's Nameless Ruins, and it's hard to miss, since there's a big statue right next to it. When you approach the chest, however, you get a riddle with little guidance as to what it means — and the statue next to you is of no use. Yet.
body: Below, we explain how to open the Nameless Ruins chest in Final Fantasy Resonance and what you get inside.

When you first examine the chest, you see this riddle: "First, a broken sword pierced the sky, bringing light. Then, a withered horse was laid to rest, becoming the land. Finally, darkness once sealed was unleashed, cleaving day from night."

The first nouns at the start of each sentence are the key here — sword, horse, darkness. There are three statues in the Nameless Ruins representing these things, and you need to examine them in that order: sword, horse, darkness. Note that you are not looking for an actual sword or horse statue. All the statues look the same, but have a different description when you interact with them. The one next to the chest is darkness, so it's no use to you initially.

articles.title: Here are our PS Plus monthly games for November 2026
articles.summary: Sony has announced the monthly games coming to PlayStation Plus Premium and Extra next month, bringing a mix of triple-A bangers and remastered classics to the service on the 3rd November.
body: Perhaps the biggest game on offer is Dead Island 2, Dambuster Studios and Deep Silver's first person zombie action game. There's plenty of grisly goodness here, and ample loot to snatch up and use against the undead hordes. It's a decent enough game, which should offer plenty of entertainment to those looking for something chunky to dig their teeth into while the Halloween spirit still lingers.

The remastered Tomb Raider Darkness Trilogy is not one to be skipped, especially if you're looking for a sizable time sink from your PlayStation Plus monthly games. While not known as being exactly the best Lara Croft games out there, Aspyr did some fine work polishing them up for modern platforms.

Finally we've got Monster Train 2. A deckbuilder roguelike that has you operating and managing trains where the forces of heaven and hell reside, all to defeat titans that threaten the orderly state of things. As the sole indie release on this monthly selection of PlayStation Plus games, it may be worth a try for those who can't get enough from the Roguelike genre even now. It even features a smug looking mushroom fella, how can you go wrong with that.

articles.title: Capcom's golden streak continues as Onimusha and Pragmata sell well, but Monster Hunter Wilds conspicuously absent from financial report
articles.summary: Capcom has revealed updated sales figures for its new and successful games, including Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Pragmata, and Resident Evil Requiem. But for some reason, Monster Hunter Wilds is absent from the report.
body: Capcom's half-year report, for the period running 1st April to 30th September, saw growth in both revenue and profit across nearly all segments of the business. In games, much of that was driven by digital sales, which continue to account for the vast majority of the publisher's income.

The first half of FY2026 was especially strong for Capcom owing to the release of multiple critically acclaimed and financially successful titles. Onimusha: Way of the Sword has now sold over 1.7m copies, up from the 1m it sold at launch. Pragmata, another critical and financial hit, has grown its tally to 2.7m copies, more than double what it sold in its first two days of release. Resident Evil Requiem, meanwhile, has now surpassed 8.5m copies sold.

As part of the same report, Capcom also recorded its highest-ever number of unit sales for the first half of any fiscal year. This is attributed to Capcom's strong back-catalogue of titles, and regular sales and discounts.

videos.summary: Vessels of preserved organic matter have begun to appear in deep space, concealed within the nooks and shadows of derelict hulks and infested space outposts. These haunted mementos have attracted a number of enigmatic traders from all corners of the universe, all set upon gathering the samples for…
body: Fortunately, these strange opportunists are only too pleased to lean on the expertise of experienced Travellers and whoever has mastered the skills of salvaging such in-demand materials. Any brave courier willing to venture into these ominous treasure troves and salvage their curious bounty can barter with forsaken traders, exchanging mementos for unique, sinisterly biomechanical corvette modules. Spook up your existing corvette exterior, or lean fully into the creepy vibe and build a whole new scarecraft.
